name: fix-ci-manifest-push
body: source: global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag 'Pushing … must be done by humans only'; inconsistency: package-manifest-update needs CI to commit formula/manifest updates in-tree (same-repo tap/bucket), which the constraint forbade (feedback-34); resolution [with user]: constraint narrowed — the CI release workflow may push manifest-only commits (version/URL/checksum updates under `Formula/` and `bucket/`); humans still push all code and create all tags; agents never push or tag. Reflected in the constraint, the package-manifest-update AC (commit touches only Formula/ and bucket/, no CI tags) and the release-workflow component. SUPERSEDED by global.note.agent-push-consent-decisions: the constraint now requires explicit, per-action human consent for any push/tag (with consent an agent may push or tag, including force-push and tag moves), so the "agents never push or tag" framing above no longer holds; the CI manifest-only carve-out it established is retained. The source statement is preserved verbatim as the historical record.
